The [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Toro Irana]], high on the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|tempest]], got into a brawl with the patrons of a '''restaurant''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] a [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] known as [[Choka Chok]] in the fighting as well as several others. Irana himself died when he misjudged his momentum and went flying through the restaurant's plate [[Glass/Legends|glass]] [[Window/Legends|window]], plummeting 40 stories to his death.
